recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed unless a work group intentionally reactivates DataElement or changes the broader StructureDefinition.mapping rule.
issue_request: FHIR-10996 was a Published FHIR-core/DataElement change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking why DataElement.mapping.name and DataElement.mapping.uri were both optional. The approved resolution kept both fields optional individually but required a constraint that at least one of name or uri be present.
initial_application: Commit 85209e020060ad784eefe3f92c61b6c5f9b0e153 ([#10996]) applied the historical change by adding invariant 3 to source/dataelement/dataelement-spreadsheet.sheet.txt with XPath exists(f:uri) or exists(f:name), FHIRPath uri.exists() or name.exists(), and linking it to DataElement.mapping.
additional_context: DataElement is no longer an active current-build resource: source/fhir.ini comments out its resource and work-group entries. StructureDefinition is active in the current build and now carries the mapping declaration surface. Its source includes constraint sdf-2 on StructureDefinition.mapping with human text "Must have at least a name or a uri (or both)" and expression "name.exists() or uri.exists()"; both name and uri reference that condition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build already contains the approved constraint in the active mapping declaration, and editing retired/commented-out DataElement source would not affect the current specification.
